result.reason: The operative language includes professional-and-workmanlike performance, a 12-month Site conformance warranty, compliance with laws, protection against malicious code, and re-performance, repair, replacement, or refund remedies, substantively reaching the preferred position. However, it unnecessarily adds a termination right without penalty or any Termination Payment, materially altering termination economics beyond the playbook. Drafting is generally professional, but the conformance period runs from the Effective Date rather than delivery or acceptance, potentially shortening the practical warranty, and conformance is limited to the defined Site rather than clearly covering every deliverable or item of software.
